notes.title: Prepare to Brave the Storm: "Unknown Memoirs: Stormy Night" Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[b]Get ready for an intense psychological horror experience like never before! [/b]

Embark on a chilling journey into the unknown with our upcoming game, "Unknown Memoirs: Stormy Night." As the Never Ending Storm wreaks havoc, prepare to delve into a world filled with paranormal events and spine-tingling horrors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44060620/b0a09f818e294e3488f65cdfc939290e632261b4.gif[/img]

Synopsis:

"Stormy Night" plunges players into the eerie chaos brought by an endless storm. Strange sightings and disturbing occurrences escalate as the storm rages into its third week. Trapped within the confines of your apartment, you're thrust into a nightmarish spiral induced by the storm's sinister presence.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44060620/95d5e32fbffe4add25ea656332cffacc98d9d4cb.gif[/img]

Gameplay Features: 

[list]
[*] [b]Walking Simulator Genre[/b]: Immerse yourself in a narrative-driven experience.
[*] [b]Realism-driven Gameplay[/b]: Experience a world where reality blurs with horror.
[*] [b]Unique 4:3 Aspect Ratio[/b]: Capturing the essence of "found footage" for added immersion.
[*] [b]Interactive Physics Objects[/b]: Engage with various in-game objects for a deeper connection.
[*] [b]Mature Content Warning[/b]: Brace for intense psychological horror elements, blood depictions, terrifying monsters, and disturbing imagery. This game is tailored for mature audiences and isn't suitable for children or those sensitive to horror and mature themes.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44060620/7a5acecab4ce8ad00ae5362084fd1e75082b5eb0.gif[/img]

Stay tuned for updates and prepare to face your fears when "Unknown Memoirs: Stormy Night" arrives in the coming months on Steam. Are you ready to step into the eye of the storm?[img]

notes.title: We want your input on the setting of our next adventure!
notes.content:
Exciting Announcement! The Second Chapter of Our New Game is on its Way!

We want your input on the setting of our next adventure. We're torn between two equally captivating options and would greatly appreciate your help in deciding!

[previewyoutube=fazdneQ8vgg;full][/previewyoutube]

Option 1: The Backrooms

This surreal setting takes you on a journey through an interconnected series of seemingly endless rooms, hallways, and corridors. Each step could lead to a new, unsettling discovery, and danger lurks around every corner. You'll have to navigate this labyrinthine maze, solve puzzles, and survive encounters with enigmatic entities that roam the Backrooms.

Option 2: The Bunker

Alternatively, we have the option of a narrative set in a bunker. Picture a post-apocalyptic world, where the protagonist finds solace and safety within the confines of an underground shelter. Outside, a harsh and unforgiving wasteland awaits, filled with the remnants of a once-thriving civilization. As the protagonist, you must gather resources, fortify your bunker, and protect yourself from the terrifying creatures and hazards that lie in wait.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

We value your opinion and would love to hear which option captures your interest the most. Do you prefer the haunting depths of the Backrooms or the intense struggle for survival in the bunker? Let us know in the comments below! Your feedback will shape the future of our game and determine the path our protagonist takes.

Stay tuned for more updates, sneak peeks, and release dates. We can't wait to embark on this thrilling adventure together.

notes.title: Chapter 2: The Bunker WIP
notes.content:
Attention, survivors of "The Unknown Memoirs"!

We are thrilled to unveil the next chilling installment of this haunting saga. Prepare to descend once again into the depths of mystery and terror in "The Unknown Memoirs: The Bunker."

[previewyoutube=5sIMGvSc_U4;full][/previewyoutube]

In this continuation, you find yourself confined to a foreboding bunker, where lurking horrors await beyond its cold, concreate walls. The veil of darkness has shrouded the world, and unknown entities prowl the outside, their intentions uncertain and their motives elusive. Your survival instincts will be put to the ultimate test as you strive to endure in this unforgiving refuge.

"The Unknown Memoirs: The Bunker" beckons, daring you to confront the unknown and uncover the dark truths that lie in wait. Prepare for an atmospheric and spine-chilling descent into terror, where survival is the ultimate prize.

Stay vigilant, for more details will be revealed soon. Gather your courage, gather your wits, and prepare for an unforgettable experience.

Survive. Uncover. Unravel.

Stay tuned for further updates!

The Unknown Memoirs Development Team

notes.title: Game Release Special 15% Off!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce the release of "Unknown Memoirs of 'The Rental", an episodic psychological horror game that will send shivers down your spine. Prepare yourself for a bone-chilling experience as you navigate a dilapidated rental apartment, uncovering the dark secrets that lie hidden within. And the best part? We're offering a special 15% discount for a limited time to celebrate the game's launch!

In this atmospheric short story horror game, players will find themselves in a world where something sinister lurks behind every corner. From the moment you step foot into your new home, you'll realize that all is not well. Eerie echoes of strange noises pierce the stillness of the night, objects mysteriously move on their own accord, and haunting visions torment your dreams.

As the protagonist, you must unravel the mysteries that shroud this crumbling building and the twisted minds of your neighbours. Prepare to explore every nook and cranny of the apartment complex, for it is within these walls that the dark secrets await your discovery. Brace yourself as you delve deeper into the abyss, peeling back the layers of the building's violent and bloody history. But beware, something malevolent still lingers, watching your every move.

"Unknown Memoirs of 'The Rental'" offers a unique gameplay experience within the "Walking Simulator" genre. With its focus on realism, the game immerses players in a hauntingly realistic world, where the line between reality and nightmares blurs.

Don't miss out on this bone-chilling adventure! For a limited time, you can get "Unknown Memoirs : The Rental'" at a 15% discounted price. Embrace the fear, uncover the truth, and face the horrors that await you in this psychological journey into darkness.
